svg.title: Feedforward network: transform each token
svg.desc: Three independent token columns, Noa at position zero, can at one, and she at five, show a subset of the six-token prefix. They use identical first projection, activation, and second projection. The feature width expands and returns to the model width. Input and output retain the same token positions. The original Transformer uses ReLU and widths 512, 2048, 512. GPT-2 uses GELU.
svg.text: Each token separately. Same weights at all positions.
Shown: positions 0, 1, 5 of the six-token prefix
